description:
Use this when the user wants clips joined into one video: "make a highlights video from these clips", "put my
top 5 together". They play in the order given; the result is a new Library clip, the originals stay. Returns job_id.
Not for: separate clips in one zip (download_all_clips). Free: no Horizon Units.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips in play order, 2-20.

shape.description: Output shape, e.g. 9:16 or 16:9; empty keeps the first clip's.

title.description: Name of the new clip, e.g. Week highlights; empty = a default.

name: combine_clips
title: Join clips into one video
